scientific_integrity: The claim was reconstructed from the defining antiderivation identity and the multiplication table, not inferred from finite experiments. Exact matrix calculations establish the three added directions and both closures. Finite grid checks are regression tests only.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the stated four-dimensional complex Lie algebra and local antiderivations. It does not classify closure behavior for arbitrary Lie algebras or arbitrary local delta-derivations. The motivating source is recent, so unindexed or later equivalent work remains a residual originality risk.
title: The local-antiderivation defect closes to a maximal parabolic in one triple step
